title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 1: a rebellious nation, sacrifices God rejects, and sins as scarlet made white as snow.

questions.explanation: The book opens with the vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz.

questions.text: Concerning which places did Isaiah see his vision?
questions.explanation: It was the vision which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

questions.text: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey knows what?
questions.explanation: The text says the ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master's crib, but Israel doesn't know.

questions.text: The daughter of Zion is left like a hut in a field of what?
questions.explanation: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

questions.text: What would Judah have been like if Yahweh of Armies had not left a very small remnant?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah."

answers.text: Like a vineyard without a wall

questions.text: Why does Yahweh say He will not hear when they make many prayers?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that when they spread out their hands He will hide His eyes, and He will not hear their many prayers, because their hands are full of blood.

answers.text: Because they pray in a foreign language
Because their hands are full of blood

questions.text: Which of these commands does Yahweh give in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow."

questions.text: Though their sins are as scarlet, what shall they be like?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool."

questions.text: What has the city's silver become?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water."

questions.text: What will the city be called after Yahweh restores its judges as at the first?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Afterward you shall be called 'The city of righteousness, a faithful town.'"

answers.text: The joy of the whole earth
